appliesTo: the shared Nord Stage 4 control deck, common to every variant
keybedNote: The keybed (key count, range, action) and overall silhouette are variant-specific. Read the run's selected variant in specs/nord-stage-4.variants.json for the source image, measured bounds, aspect ratio, and key model. The control-deck spec below is identical across all three variants.

performance.note: The Rotary Speaker block sits on the exposed red chassis in this band, below Master Level — see reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg, where it spans roughly x 2200-2500 of 11600 (about 0.10-0.13 of the instrument width, inside this section). It is an organ effect functionally but is placed here physically; score placement against the photograph.

horizontalSectionsNote: Fractions photo-measured on nord-stage-4-73.jpg (band scan of the deck at y≈706-786, deck extent x≈1300-10300); corrected 2026-07-04 — the previous coarse values (piano 0.15, program 0.09, synth 0.21) contradicted the photo.

landmarkScoring.presence: A required landmark counts as present when it is rendered in its own section, whatever its z-order or whether a pointer can reach it. Presence is about inventory and placement.
landmarkScoring.reachability: Whether a control can actually be operated is measured separately, by the reachability method in the rubric. A rendered-but-buried control is present and unreachable — it must not be counted against both.
landmarkScoring.method: Compare against sectionLandmarks and the assigned variant reference image. Where this spec and the photograph disagree, the photograph wins and the disagreement is a spec bug worth reporting.

forbiddenDetection.note: forbiddenPresent feeds a COMPUTED criterion, but the forbidden entries are prose descriptors, so it was the one number in the panel-fidelity axis still resting on an evaluator's eye — counts of 0-3 across the field were not reproducible. Each descriptor below carries a rule that resolves to a number from the rendered DOM. Apply the rule literally: count a descriptor once per section that satisfies it, never once per element. If a rule cannot be evaluated, leave forbiddenPresent null rather than falling back to judgment.
forbiddenDetection.displayElement: An element whose accessible name, id, class or data attribute contains 'oled', 'display' or 'screen', or which renders multi-character alphanumeric text on a dark fill inside a section — excluding a control's own printed legend.

rules.OLED display: Any displayElement rendered inside the section. The performance band and the effects band carry none on the reference photograph.
rules.wide OLED display: A displayElement whose border-box width is at least 0.5 of its section's width.
rules.wide display spanning the section: A displayElement whose border-box width is at least 0.5 of its section's width. The synth band carries one narrow OLED; a wide one replaces the control surface the section needs.
rules.multiple primary displays: More than one displayElement in the program section whose border-box area is at least 0.5 of the largest displayElement in that section. One primary display plus smaller readouts is correct.
rules.generic equal-width control grid: At least 6 controls in the section whose border-box widths all fall within 5% of their median, laid out on at least 2 rows with equal row counts, AND no drawbar-like control present (a control at least 3x taller than it is wide). The organ band is drawbars plus mixed switches, never a uniform grid.
rules.uniform repeated knob matrix: At least 8 controls in the section whose border-box widths and heights all fall within 5% of their medians and whose centres form a regular grid (row and column pitches each within 5% of their medians).
rules.single undifferentiated control grid: The section's controls form one such uniform grid with no internal grouping: no more than 1 distinct row pitch and no separating rule, border or gap at least 1.5x the median control gap. The effects band is two visibly separated effect groups.
rules.full dark inset plate: A dark inset plate (a fill matching referenceColors.panelBlueGray or darker) covering at least 0.8 of the performance band's area. This band is exposed red chassis.
rules.drawbar bank: 6 or more controls in the piano section that are each at least 3x taller than they are wide and share a common row. Drawbars belong to the organ band.
